history.question: React, a powerful JavaScript library
history.answer: In our enterprise production applications, we leverage React's functional components and custom hooks to build high-performance, maintainable user interfaces. We rely on the Virtual DOM and React Fiber reconciliation engine to efficiently batch DOM updates, while optimizing heavy computations with useMemo and stabilizing callback references with useCallback to prevent unnecessary child re-renders. For complex global state management, we typically pair React with Zustand or Redux Toolkit, ensuring clean separation of concerns and predictable state transitions across large component trees.
